FFmpeg third-party notice
=========================

SRTune may bundle the ffmpeg.exe command-line program to provide subtitle burning
and video export.

FFmpeg is a separate third-party executable launched by SRTune. It is not linked
into the SRTune application binary.

Upstream project:
https://ffmpeg.org/

Windows build provider used by the SRTune release tooling:
Gyan Doshi / CODEX FFMPEG
https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/

License
-------

The Gyan Windows FFmpeg builds used by this project are distributed under the
GNU General Public License version 3 (GPLv3).

GPLv3 license text:
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html

FFmpeg licensing information:
https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html

Exact bundled version
---------------------

The exact version and configuration of the bundled executable can be displayed
with:

    ffmpeg.exe -version
    ffmpeg.exe -buildconf

For the SRTune 1.0.0 release candidate tested by the project, the bundled
executable reports FFmpeg 9.0.2 from the Gyan Windows builds.

Corresponding upstream source for FFmpeg 9.0.2:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/946fcce07b

The Gyan build page also publishes source-code links for its current release
builds:
https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/

No warranty
-----------

FFmpeg is provided under its own license and without any additional warranty
from the SRTune project. SRTune is derived from Aegisub under the licensing
terms provided separately in LICENCE.txt.
